verdict.rationale: Amplitude Experiment's own docs say it runs A/B, multivariate, and bandit tests on flags. Flags support any number of variants, can be converted into experiments, and the docs reference shipping 'the winning variant'. However, the pack has no detail on choosing metrics, viewing results, or how a winner is determined statistically. Missing for 10: documented metric selection and results/analysis views showing which variant wins, statistical significance details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Run A/B, multivariate, and bandit tests so the data, not the loudest opinion, makes the call.
You can add as many variants as you want to a flag.
You can create an experiment directly or convert an existing flag to an experiment.
ship the winning variant without a code deploy
